title: [Feature Request] Hotkey to switch model 🙏
body: Userstory: I am typing a long prompt, and realise midway that I need the extra intelligence of Opus, unfortunately I currently have sonnet selected. This is annoying to deal with and would be a huge UX improvement to let me change between the model(modes) via a hotkey or similar
author: kim-borgen

top_comments.author: semmlerino
top_comments.body: Yes! That would be so incredibly helpful.

top_comments.author: arrrggghhh
top_comments.body: I came here because of this problem too. It's essential to be able to change models in the middle of writing prompts.
